content.equation:
BMI = Total_Body_Weight / sq(Height / 100)
LBW = (9270 * Total_Body_Weight) / (8780 + (244 * BMI))
notes: This equation was developed using data from individuals weighing between 40.7 to 216.5 kg (BMI: 17.1 to 69.9 kg/m2). It was validated in patients weighing between 47.6 and 131.7 kg (BMI: 18.7 to 38.4 kg/m2).
